_note: Our own reporting. wire.py reads this every run and places these on the homepage and the right section page, above the syndicated wire cards. Originated items do not expire on the 7-day wire timer - they are ours and they stay.

articles.title: PRESS RELEASE: SKVLK Fest Thanks Families and Community After Joyful 18th Birthday Celebration; Sheriff Confirms No Stabbing
articles.dek: More than 400 security professionals, shuttle buses for guests and thousands of young people celebrating: organizers thank the community that made Jamie Foxx’s daughter’s festival a night to remember.
articles.byline: Issued by PR STARPOWER
articles.disclosure: Issued by PR STARPOWER on behalf of SKVLK Fest. PR STARPOWER and Newswire Hollywood are sister companies.

articles.title: PRESS RELEASE: Sheriff's Investigation Finds No Stabbing at Jamie Foxx's SKVLK Fest Halloween Party
articles.dek: The Ventura County Sheriff's Office investigated and confirmed that no one was stabbed, contrary to widespread media reports. The official release, with photos and video.
articles.byline: Issued by PR STARPOWER
articles.disclosure: Issued by PR STARPOWER on behalf of SKVLK Fest. PR STARPOWER and Newswire Hollywood are sister companies.

articles.title: Ramayana Makes UK History: First Indian Film Ever to Open No. 1 at the UK and Ireland Box Office
articles.dek: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash's epic opened to £2.1 million and took the top spot from every Hollywood release. Worldwide, only Godzilla beat it. Is this the moment Indian cinema goes fully mainstream in the West?
articles.byline: By the International Desk, Newswire Hollywood
articles.signed_off_by: Terry Bryant, Senior Editor (standing sign-off, Breaking News Desk, Nov 5 2026)
articles.revenue_angle: Amazon link to the Ramayana in translation; the UK and US South Asian diaspora is a strong ad and sponsor market, and the box-office series (previews, opening, UK record, Part Two) builds repeat search traffic.

articles.title: VisionQuest Finale Ends Marvel's WandaVision Saga With Two Post-Credits Scenes Aimed at Avengers: Doomsday
articles.dek: Paul Bettany's Vision got his family back, and Marvel tucked two codas into the last hour that point straight at December 18. Is Wanda really coming home?
articles.byline: By the Television Desk, Newswire Hollywood
articles.signed_off_by: Terry Bryant, Senior Editor (standing sign-off, Breaking News Desk, Nov 5 2026)
articles.revenue_angle: Amazon link to WandaVision on disc; Marvel search traffic peaks into Avengers: Doomsday on Dec 18, so this is the first of a ad-friendly run of Doomsday coverage.

articles.dek: The R&B rivals-turned-partners revealed their first-ever Las Vegas residency live on Dancing With the Stars, 28 years after the song that made them a pair. Ten nights, one theater, presales this week. Are you going?
articles.byline: By the Music Desk, Newswire Hollywood

articles.title: Russell Brand Found Guilty of Rape, Taken Into Custody as Judge Warns of 'Significant' Prison Term
articles.dek: A London jury convicted the comedian on four of seven counts after eight and a half hours. His bail is gone, and sentencing is Monday. How did it come to this?
articles.byline: By the News Desk, Newswire Hollywood
articles.signed_off_by: Terry Bryant, Senior Editor (standing sign-off, Breaking News Desk, Nov 5 2026)
articles.revenue_angle: No shopping links on a sexual-assault story, by policy. Value is traffic and search authority (SEO, ad impressions) plus the Monday sentencing follow-up.

articles.title: Godzilla Minus Zero Stomps Into 3,254 Theaters, Tracking Nearly Triple the Last Monster's Opening
articles.dek: The sequel to the Oscar-winning Godzilla Minus One is tracking near $30 million at home and about $60 million worldwide this weekend. Can a Japanese monster movie save a dead box office?
articles.byline: By the Film Desk, Newswire Hollywood
articles.signed_off_by: Terry Bryant, Senior Editor (standing sign-off, Breaking News Desk, Nov 5 2026)
articles.revenue_angle: Amazon affiliate link to Godzilla Minus One (catch-up viewing before the sequel); weekend box-office follow-up drives repeat traffic Sunday.

articles.title: Ramayana Makes History: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash Epic Posts the Biggest Bollywood Previews Ever in North America
articles.dek: About $2 million from US and Canadian premieres and over Rs 140 crore in worldwide advance sales. Is this the moment Indian cinema goes full blockbuster in America?
articles.byline: By the International Desk, Newswire Hollywood
articles.signed_off_by: Terry Bryant, Senior Editor (standing sign-off, Breaking News Desk, Nov 5 2026)
articles.revenue_angle: Amazon affiliate link to the Ramayana epic in translation; South Asian diaspora audience is a strong sponsor and ad market for a follow-up box-office series.

articles.dek: The Authentic Global Film Festival brings purpose-driven cinema from roughly 30 countries to the Writers Guild Theater, with screenings from 10 AM, a red carpet at 5 PM, a panel at 6 PM, the awards from 7 to 9 PM and an after-party at 10 PM.

articles.title: Blue Wave Hits America: Democracy Stood, and Democrats Swept
articles.dek: Democrats took the House and the Senate, flipped governor's mansions from Texas to Georgia, and gave California its first Latino governor. For the business of entertainment, the Washington that regulates it just changed hands.
articles.byline: By the Washington Desk, Newswire Hollywood

articles.title: Peter Rice takes charge of Netflix's content this week. Here is what he inherits
articles.dek: The former Disney television chief became Netflix's chief content officer on October 26, replacing Bela Bajaria and taking charge of a programming budget of roughly $20 billion, in the same month the company cut about 1,000 jobs.
articles.byline: By the Deals Desk, Newswire Hollywood

articles.title: Freda Payne Set Hollywood on Fire
articles.dek: On VMAs weekend, with every camera in Los Angeles pointed at the Peacock Theater, the hottest ticket in the city was a sold-out jazz room on Sunset — and an 84-year-old legend in gold lamé who sang her heroes back into the room.
articles.byline: By the Music Desk, Newswire Hollywood

articles.title: PRESS RELEASE: Freda Payne's “Legendary Ladies of Song” plays to a sold-out Catalina Jazz Club
articles.dek: Don B. Welch presents the legendary Freda Payne in a sold-out tribute to nine women who built American jazz and pop, staged on Sunset Boulevard on VMAs weekend.
articles.byline: Supplied by the production
articles.photo_licence: Supplied for editorial use with credit

articles.title: Taylor Swift extends her Video of the Year record, Madonna wins seven and takes Artist of the Year
articles.dek: Taylor Swift won Video of the Year for a sixth time, a record nobody else is near. Madonna returned to the stage after twenty-three years and walked off with seven. Snoop Dogg hosted from the Peacock Theater.
articles.byline: By the Music Desk, Newswire Hollywood

articles.title: VMAs return to Los Angeles Sunday: Madonna opens after 23 years, Snoop Dogg hosts, Nirvana takes the Vanguard
articles.dek: The 2026 MTV Video Music Awards air live from Los Angeles on Sunday. Madonna leads all nominees with thirteen and opens the show. Taylor Swift receives a newly created honor, and premieres a video during the broadcast.
articles.byline: By the Music Desk, Newswire Hollywood

articles.title: Usher and Chris Brown take SoFi Stadium tonight, night two of three in Los Angeles
articles.dek: The co-headlining R&B Tour runs 33 stadium dates across North America. Los Angeles gets three of them — last night, tonight, and a return in November.
articles.byline: By the Music Desk, Newswire Hollywood

articles.title: Paramount settles with 12 state attorneys general to save its $111 billion Warner Bros. Discovery takeover
articles.dek: The deal survives a lawsuit that could have killed it — at the cost of a film-output floor, a promise to run the two studios separately, and an FCC ruling that clears the merged company to be 49.5% foreign-owned.
articles.byline: By the Deals Desk, Newswire Hollywood

articles.title: Zach Cregger's 'Resident Evil' opens to a franchise-best $108 million
articles.dek: The video-game adaptation posts the biggest opening the series has ever had, and a long-dead 'World War Z' sequel comes back to life with Brad Pitt returning and Edward Berger directing.
articles.byline: By the Film Desk, Newswire Hollywood

articles.title: Emmys 2026: the winners
articles.dek: The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards aired Monday from the Peacock Theater, hosted by Mariska Hargitay. "Hacks" took Outstanding Comedy Series in its final season, Jean Smart and Matthew Rhys won lead acting categories, and the red carpet delivered on the archival-over-custom forecast.
articles.byline: By the Awards Desk, Newswire Hollywood

articles.title: Toronto opens with 'Being Heumann,' Sian Heder's follow-up to 'CODA'
articles.dek: The 51st Toronto International Film Festival opened September 10 with the world premiere of a biopic on disability rights activist Judy Heumann, from the director whose last film won Best Picture.
articles.byline: By the Film Desk, Newswire Hollywood

articles.title: 'The Odyssey' breaks IMAX's all-time box office record
articles.dek: $289 million in IMAX alone, passing Avatar's $270 million record, on the way to $1.627 billion worldwide - the highest-grossing R-rated film in history.
articles.byline: By the Deals Desk, Newswire Hollywood

articles.title: Sony Music Publishing, Warner Chappell sue Anthropic over song lyrics in AI training data
articles.dek: 35 music publishers filed suit August 28, alleging Claude was trained on copyrighted lyrics obtained by scraping and torrenting, seeking statutory damages of up to $150,000 per work. Filed, not resolved.
articles.byline: By the AI & Technology Desk, Newswire Hollywood

articles.title: Freda Payne returns to Catalina with a tribute to the women who built the songbook
articles.dek: The two-time Grammy nominee brings Legendary Ladies of Jazz to Hollywood on September 26, with her son Gregory Abbott Jr. hosting and Thomasina Gross channeling Eartha Kitt.
articles.byline: By the Music Desk, Newswire Hollywood
